'''Jorral''' is a historian located at his [[Outpost]], which is surrounded by [[Aggressiveness|aggressive]] level 64 [[Wolf|wolves]] and level 42 [[hobgoblin]]s, north of West Ardougne. He starts the [[Making History]] [[Quests|quest]]. During Making History, Jorral enlists the help of the player to save the outpost from [[King Lathas]] by researching its past. After the player saves the outpost, Jorral turns it into a small museum.

He also features in [[The Slug Menace]] quest, where the player takes a [[Door transcription|transcript of the runes]] to take him for translating which leads him to describing [[Mother Mallum]]'s history.

The quickest way to get to Jorral is by using the [[Necklace of passage]]'s outpost option.

== Treasure Trails ==
Jorral plays a major role in master difficulty [[Treasure Trails]]. During a [[hot & cold]] [[master clue]] which directs players to speak to Jorral, he will give players a [[strange device]] needed to locate the next clue or casket. '''Note:''' The Making History quest must be completed before accepting the strange device from Jorral and proceeding with any master Hot Cold clue.
